_comment: model_version: the hub metadata model_version for this model; calibration: spread multipliers around the median for horizons 0-3, per target; refit: retrain on all windows after early stopping; holiday_shift: per target, an upward shift on the model's z scale (log1p(value * scale)) of forecasts whose target week contains Christmas ("christmas") or New Year's Day ("newyear"); absent: none
